async def act(page):
    # Ensure the status filter is set to 'Suspected Fraud' and apply it
    # Locate the combobox for status in the filter row
    filter_row = page.get_by_role('row').filter(has=page.get_by_role('cell', name='Any'))
    status_combobox = filter_row.get_by_role('combobox').nth(7)  # Based on tree, it's the 8th combobox in that row
    await status_combobox.select_option(label='Suspected Fraud')
    # Click the 'Search' button to apply the filter
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Search').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Sort by 'Purchased On' to get the earliest order
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Purchased On').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Get the first data row after the header and filter rows
    # In the tree, after filtering, data rows should appear; if 'No records found.', this will fail
    # Use try-except to handle no records case
    try:
        first_data_row = page.get_by_role('row').nth(2)  # Index 0 is header row, 1 is filter row, 2 is first data row
        customer_name_cell = first_data_row.get_by_role('cell').nth(4)  # Bill to Name is the 5th cell (index 4)
        customer_name = await customer_name_cell.text_content()
        return customer_name.strip()
    except Exception as e:
        # If no data rows, return an indication
        return 'No fraud suspect orders found'
